_about: Default settings only, never Luke's data. Change numbers here, never in prose. Each entry: value, source, note.

defaultHours.note: Average non-24 cycle for Rikki and Luke.

averageOverCycles.note: Wake-to-wake spans averaged for the cycle dial.

fastMultiplier.note: Half-life multiplier for the quick-clearance edge of the range.

slowMultiplier.note: Half-life multiplier for the slow edge. Wide because of Luke's kidney and liver values.

nsaid.note: Contribution of the NSAID level to estimated pain relief.

opioid.note: Contribution of the opioid level to estimated pain relief.

thinning.note: At or above, but below 'covered': 'thinning'. Below: 'likely gap'.

opioidFollowUpMinutes.note: Optional pain check after an opioid dose.

painCheckHighFraction.note: A pain check at or above this share of the maximum score counts as 'high' for learning.

learningMinQualifyingChecks.note: Qualifying checks needed before showing Luke's observed relief window.

reminderDays.note: Gentle reminder when the last backup is older than this.

normalRestingMin.note: Breaths per minute, asleep or calmly resting.

hhhhhmmAcceptableTotal.note: Commonly read as acceptable. A conversation tool, never a verdict (S7).

dogCreatinineStageUpperBounds.source: IRIS 2023 guidelines, not verified against the official page
dogCreatinineStageUpperBounds.note: mg/dL. Below 1.4 = stage 1; 1.4 to 2.8 = stage 2; 2.9 to 5.0 = stage 3; above 5.0 = stage 4. Valid only when stable and hydrated.

dogSdmaStageUpperBounds.source: IRIS 2023 guidelines, not verified against the official page
dogSdmaStageUpperBounds.note: µg/dL. Below 18 = stage 1; 18 to 35 = stage 2; 36 to 54 = stage 3; above 54 = stage 4.

firstSessionMaxQuestions.note: Blocking questions per round. The rest go to DECISIONS.md under Open.

feelFirstPassPieces.note: Artistic interpretations in the first Feel tab pass.
